TREE: MUJI's PLPs are Next.js App Router pages, so the taxonomy is not in the raw HTML. I found that each section page's React flight payload (self.__next_f) carries, for that section: sectionCode, sectionName, isLeafSection, and the FULL breadcrumb chain as the site itself stores it - which is the authoritative parentage source BATCH_BRIEF s5 asks for (parentage from the page's own data, never from URL shape - and MUJI's codes deliberately do not encode parentage: the Mirror node is S1070111 but its parent is T20008). I also found that requesting a section with an 'RSC: 1' header returns just that payload (~310KB in ~0.9s instead of a ~2MB HTML page). I then did NOT rely on the mega-menu, which only exposes department level and would have truncated exactly as BATCH_BRIEF s5 warns: instead I took MUJI's own declared category sitemap https://www.muji.com/jp/sitemap_xml/sitemap_jp_section_1.xml (from a robots.txt Sitemap: line), 1,484 section codes = the complete server-side taxonomy including any orphan, and WALKED ALL 1,484 via the RSC route, checkpointing to disk and resuming across four passes. Result: 1,484 sections resolved, 0 errors, each with name, isLeafSection and full breadcrumb. That is the complete MUJI Japan category tree, and it is what every statement below is checked against. THE BATHROOM DEPARTMENT: 生活雑貨 (Household Goods) > D00033 タオル・バス・トイレ用品 (Towels, Bath & Toilet Goods), 188 products, isLeafSection false, with exactly two children - T20020 タオル (Towels, 42) and T20035 バス・トイレ用品 (Bath & Toilet Goods, 146). The arithmetic closes EXACTLY at both levels and is a strong structural check on the counts: 111+14+15+6 = 146 = T20035, and 42+146 = 188 = D00033. There is therefore NO rule-24 residue anywhere in this department - every product under D00033 is covered by a leaf. QTY SOURCE AND PROOF: MUJI renders its own exact total on every section page in the form 'N件中 X件〜Y件表示' (N items, showing X-Y). I used that rendered figure and then proved it three ways. (3) The parent/child sums close exactly, as above. Counts discriminate per node (188 / 146 / 111 / 42 / 27 / 17 / 15 / 15 / 14 / 13 / 9 / 8 / 6) - no constant, no round-number cap. COMPOSITION DISCLOSURE - READ THIS BEFORE USING THE 111: I enumerated all 111 products in Bathroom Goods (バスルーム用品) rather than accepting the node on its name. It is a genuinely MIXED node. Roughly 40 items are Bathroom product squarely inside rules 3/13/17: bath stools (Ag+ antibacterial 風呂いす in two seat heights, polypropylene 風呂いす), wash basins and bath buckets (ポリプロピレン片手桶, ポリプロピレン湯桶), EVA hanging bath slippers, four stainless bottle racks and a bottle tray (ステンレスボトルラック slim/small/large, ステンレスボトルトレー), soap dishes (発泡ウレタン石けん置き plus its replacement sponges, ステンレスソープディッシュ), a porcelain tray, two bath clocks (アナログ/デジタルバスクロック), roughly sixteen PET refill bottles in clear and white with foam variants, their pump heads, identification rings and labels, a refill-pouch hanging nozzle, refill jars, and two bottle brushes. The other roughly 70 are consumables and body-care that are NOT Bathroom under rule 2: sensitive-skin body soaps and hand soap and body milk with their refills, body towels and body nets and foaming balls, scalp and shower brushes, a pumice stone, bath-cleaning foam cleaners and dilution sets, and a large bath-additive block (海塩のバスソルト, 薬用炭酸タブレット, 薬用温感入浴剤 in many scents and sizes, plus IDEE aromatic bath salts). I am recording the node because it is MUJI's own deepest Bathroom leaf, it carries no children to descend into, rule 24 forbids inventing a sub-node, and its consumable majority maps to no category in this run (unlike Kmart's bath mats, whose majority mapped to Textile and were therefore routed out) - but the run owner should know that roughly 40 of the 111 are the bathroom hardware. Hooks, Clips & Towel Hangers (15) is pure hardware - stainless and aluminium S-hooks, anti-swivel hooks, wire clips, over-door hooks, and two aluminium suction TOWEL HANGERS - which rule 17 includes explicitly and rule 22 confirms metal never excludes.
